title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache + hygiene
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: our combined CI workflow has grown slow and brittle; lint/test/release jobs run serially and cache keys are noisy which causes frequent cold-cache misses. This PR splits the monolithic workflow into three focused workflows (lint, test, release), standardizes reusable cache setup, upgrades common GH actions, and applies general CI hygiene (reduce matrix explosion, dedupe job steps). Key outcomes: faster feedback for lint and tests, improved cache hit rates, simpler release job with clearer gating. Changes include: - split workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml; - introduce .github/actions/cache-setup for a centralized cache key strategy; - bump actions/checkout and setup-node to latest stable; - reduce Node matrix from [14,16,18] to [16,18] for runtime projects and keep explicit E2E matrix for release; - add parallelism for lint across packages and enable test sharding for large suites; - CI hygiene: remove legacy redundant steps, consolidate environment variables, improve job names and annotations; - docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md to document new local CI steps and how to read cache keys. Checklist: [x] split workflows and validate local runs; [x] CI passes in fork and branch; [x] reviewers approved; [x] release job tested against staging tag. Related: Linear ENG-4123, ENG-4210.
